column2: Just an ordinary face... The face of a brother thinking of his little brother...
That's why I couldn't... lay a hand on your brother, Rudi... on the king...
So that's how it was...
Rudi... That pendant on your chest. Is it the same as your brother's?
Savia v
...I see.
I'm sorry. I suppose I've been fighting too long...
I never even noticed that...
It's fine... We're the ones who'll calm this chaos and make this a peaceful country...
Starting now.
Rudi...
Savia... You were... one of the assassins...
There's something I need to ask you...
Was it... was it you who killed my brother...?
...No, Rudi.
It's true I deceived you and meant to kill the king...
But I didn't do it... The nobles did...
They knew all about me, and they deceived you.
I thought I was the one deceiving you, but they were using me...
You may not believe a word I say, but...
Those nobles set a trap for you and your brother to seize the throne...
No...
It's true... That's how they work...
Western nobles, Eastern nobles... All they ever think about is how to line their own pockets.
Your brother was at odds with the nobles...
He said the country had to be united or disaster would follow, and the powerful nobles turned on him.
They pinned the blame on you and took the throne's power into their own hands.
Because they knew we were plotting in secret to kill the royal family...
That's insane... My brother was trying to unite the country because he took the Empire's threat seriously...
Western nobles, Eastern nobles, they're all the same... They'll do anything to save their own skins... Filthy wretches...
If they keep this up... they'll play right into the Empire's hands...
The Empire's demons are right on our doorstep... Damn it!!
That's why we're getting rid of those foolish nobles... They're a disease killing this country...
No, what you're doing is wrong... Stop fighting right now and prepare for the imperial army.
Rudi, you're naive... Someone has to take action...
